verdict.rationale: Docusign documents generic agreement preparation and online approval collection: send, sign and approve documents, reusable shared templates, configurable workflows, delegated signing, and identity verification. These could carry board consents, but nothing in the evidence addresses board consents or resolutions specifically. missing for 10: board-consent/resolution-specific templates or workflows, board-member or quorum approval tracking, governance/minute-book recordkeeping, independent or hands-on corroboration of use for board approvals.
